title: Wrap text to a width
summary: Re-flow the words of standard input into lines of at most WIDTH characters.
hints: Keep the current column `col` (the length of the line you are building). A word fits if `col + 1 + strlen(word) <= width`; if so print a space and the word.
Otherwise print a newline and start the next line with the word (a word longer than the width gets its own line). Print a final newline only if something was written.
